games.title: Oh No, Thello!
games.blurb: Reversi meets Minesweeper.

games.title: The End of the World Was Nice
Roomba Rights of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: Collect the baskets before the vacuum finds you. Its route is hidden, so you have to guess.

games.title: Gwen's Peregrination II
games.blurb: You are Gwen, and there are 2,000 miles to walk. Pick yer pace, eat snax, forage, wash dishes for jools, sit through the ad breaks, and maybe earn a learner's permit. Made in VB.NET for Nonbinary Game Jam 2026, rebuilt in Odin for the browser.

games.title: How Am I Still Waiting for the Bus?
Go Get the Thing!
games.blurb: Run around a room, get the Thing, spend the coins, get faster. Then prestige.

games.title: JetLag
games.blurb: A jet climbs the screen. Steer between the blocks, grab coins, bank them before you crash. Long runs score big.

games.title: Kordanor's Cabal
games.blurb: A turn-based dungeon crawler that looks like it was written for the VIC-20. Take on the Cabal of Kordanor under the church.

games.title: Nursing Home Cat of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: You are the therapy cat at a care home. Everyone wants a visit, nobody wants the same kind of visit, and you cannot see them all.

games.title: Chaotic Space Mappers of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: Survey a hundred stars in a cube of space. Set a heading, engage, refuel from what you have charted, and do not trust a star that is a wormhole.

games.title: Rats in the Cellar
games.blurb: Kill ten rats before dawn. Lure them out, read the danger line, and know when to climb back up to the tavern. An example world for a card engine.

games.title: Key Seeker of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: A text RPG built from mazes: find the key to the next place, pull the lever. Ported from VB.NET to Odin for the browser in 2026.

games.title: Click the Yellow Rhombus
games.blurb: There is a yellow rhombus. Click it for points, miss it and lose points. Sixty seconds. A TIC-80 cartridge, ported to Odin for the browser in 2026.

games.title: Wonting of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: Two coins, one town: Crowns buy some things, Jools buy others, and the exchange in the middle trades at a loss. Then a forest maze, a graveyard and a sixteen-floor tower. Ported from VB.NET to Odin for the browser in 2026.

games.title: Skirmishers of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: A hex-and-counter wargame of kobold bands under fog of war: slingers, archers, armoured heavies, pikes that strike first, a champion and a Wololo who blesses and curses. Forest, hills and roads shape every fight, and custom battles let you pick the ground and buy your army.

games.title: Krimmis
games.blurb: Your first day as Assistant to the Regional Manager of Joy, and your name is on the List. Twenty-four days to Krimmis Eve to inform your way off it.

games.title: Gods of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: A god game. A small tribe forages, crafts, hunts, keeps a fire and tries to last the winter. You have faith and five miracles, and can help or smite.

games.title: Handies for Cash!
games.blurb: A text metaphor about giving handies in exchange for cash, in a dark alley: solicit, salvage sammiches, wash off the filth, and try not to starve. No explicit content. Ported from VB.NET to Odin for the browser in 2026.

games.title: Clumsy Oaf of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: A turn-based, text-based soulslike for Soulslike Game Jam #3: slimes in a maze show their next move, so dodge, parry, die, respawn at the checkpoint and spend yer cruor on being less clumsy. Ported from VB.NET to Odin for the browser in 2026.

games.title: Chem-Grid
games.blurb: Place atoms on an 8x8 grid, match every bond and close molecules for points. Endless mode with online top scores, and twenty puzzle levels.

games.title: Chores of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: You play as a cleaning lady, because that's obviously fun, right? Sweep the dirt into the bin (pile it too high and a dread dust bunny appears), wash 25 dishes, and get 25 shirts through a washer that explodes. Made in Defold for GlamJam 2025, ported to Odin for the browser in 2026.

games.title: Ichthyophiles of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: A virtual pet: keep one fish alive on the real clock. Feed it as often as you like, but five days of food in the tank kills it, and so do five days without. You never see how much food is in there, only how fat or skinny it looks. People are bad at taking care of things.

games.title: Blustery Bulwark of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: A gale flattened yer farm, and His Lordship's herald says His Lordship did it. Climb his windy bulwark, floor by floor, and have a word. A tile-based roguelike in the spirit of Castle of the Winds. Early days: three generated floors to walk so far.

games.title: Cluster Conquerors of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: Conquer the cluster. Everybody hates you, and the Homeowners' Association has been notified. A turn-based space strategy game in the spirit of the original Master of Orion. Early days: a generated cluster of stars to look at so far.

games.title: Bush Master of SPLORR!!
games.blurb: One fenced plot, one berry bush, one basket. Pick berries, drop 'em in, get jools. The bush grows them back. Early days: the first plot.
